title: Week 13 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “civil right”?
options: A legal guarantee of equal status, participation, or protection.
Government action preventing publication or expression before it occurs.
A central-bank purchase or sale of securities affecting reserves and short-term rates.
The condition that available resources are insufficient to satisfy every possible want.
questions.explanation: Civil right means a legal guarantee of equal status, participation, or protection.
choices: A legal guarantee of equal status, participation, or protection.
Government action preventing publication or expression before it occurs.
A central-bank purchase or sale of securities affecting reserves and short-term rates.
The condition that available resources are insufficient to satisfy every possible want.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “equal protection”?
options: The Fourteenth Amendment principle requiring states to govern persons without unconstitutional discrimination.
A plan for measuring whether a policy caused intended results and what else occurred.
The distribution of a tax’s economic burden between buyers and sellers.
A market with many firms selling differentiated products and relatively easy entry.
questions.explanation: Equal protection means the Fourteenth Amendment principle requiring states to govern persons without unconstitutional discrimination.

A plan for measuring whether a policy caused intended results and what else occurred.
The distribution of a tax’s economic burden between buyers and sellers.
A market with many firms selling differentiated products and relatively easy entry.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “state action”?
options: A measure of average price change for a defined basket of consumer goods and services.
Conduct attributable to government and therefore subject to many constitutional limits.
Ability to produce at a lower opportunity cost.
Law developed through judicial decisions, custom, and precedent.
questions.explanation: State action means conduct attributable to government and therefore subject to many constitutional limits.
choices: A measure of average price change for a defined basket of consumer goods and services.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “suspect classification”?
options: Public programs pooling risks such as unemployment, disability, health cost, or old-age income.
A legislature’s grant of authority to an executive agency or official.
Legal authority to spend public money for a designated purpose.
A classification receiving especially demanding judicial review, such as race under equal-protection doctrine.
questions.explanation: Suspect classification means a classification receiving especially demanding judicial review, such as race under equal-protection doctrine.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “disparate treatment”?
options: Organization of resources under uncertainty to create or improve products and processes.
A competing conclusion or objection that an argument must address fairly.
Intentional different treatment based on a protected characteristic.
The agreement creating proportional representation in the House and equal state representation in the Senate.
questions.explanation: Disparate treatment means intentional different treatment based on a protected characteristic.
choices: Organization of resources under uncertainty to create or improve products and processes.

Intentional different treatment based on a protected characteristic.
The agreement creating proportional representation in the House and equal state representation in the Senate.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “disparate impact”?
options: Gains from exchange lost when policy or distortion prevents mutually beneficial transactions.
A tax, subsidy, rule, service, information requirement, public investment, legal right, or other mechanism used to pursue a goal.
A good commonly used with another good.
A facially neutral practice producing unequal effects, which has different legal significance under different statutes.

questions.question: Which action best demonstrates mastery of the Week 13 inquiry?
options: A student selects an answer only because it sounds confident, even when the record is incomplete or contradictory.
A student separates constitutional equal-protection analysis from statutory discrimination rules and identifies the government or private actor involved.
A student relies on political identity, advertising, or personal preference as a substitute for documented analysis.
A student accepts the first available claim or offer without checking the source, terms, evidence, or consequences.
